description: Set up standing forwarding from a bucket to a URL. Pass forward_all:true to forward every event, or condition_tree to forward only matching events (same AND/OR condition grammar the routing engine uses). Creates the destination and routing rule in one call.

condition_tree.description: A condition tree (AND/OR of field comparisons) to forward only matching events. Mutually exclusive with forward_all.

rule_name.description: Optional name for the routing rule when using condition_tree.

name: forward_bucket
